acceptance.claimBoundary: Acceptance proves compatible enforcement in both local repositories at exact commits; it does not prove deployment, hosted execution, production behavior, or customer outcomes.
acceptance.decisionAuthority: repository owners for Proofloom and AgentFlow
evidenceRequired: AgentFlow rejects v1, dirty, stale, authority-drifted, source-mismatched, and unverified approved handoffs before immutable-plan binding or dispatch.
A cross-repository fixture proves v2 import, plan binding, execution, receipt, and Proofloom receipt audit against exact commits.

completionCriteria: AgentFlow adopts the governed-task-handoff v2 schema and independently verifies repository currency before plan binding or dispatch.
Approved authority without current repository proof remains non-executable in AgentFlow, not only in Proofloom.
The imported backlog preserves IDs, dependencies, ownership, acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, and validation equivalence.
The returned receipt remains bound to the exact v2 handoff digest and passes Proofloom receipt-integrity validation.
Both repository owners record acceptance at exact commits before end-to-end enforcement is claimed.
nonObjectives: Do not write to the AgentFlow repository from this Proofloom task without separately authorized cross-repository scope.
Do not keep v1 executable as a compatibility escape hatch.
Do not treat local cross-repository fixtures as hosted or production execution proof.
objective: Make AgentFlow independently enforce handoff v2 so the trust boundary exists on both sides of execution.
title: Enforce handoff v2 inside AgentFlow
